question: Choose the antonym of 'affirm':
solution:
The correct answer is: **Refuse**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"affirm"** means to state something as true or to confirm or assert strongly. (पुष्टि करना / दृढ़ता से कहना)

 
 
• **Example: **He affirmed his commitment to the project during the meeting.
 
 
 
• **"Refuse"** is the antonym of "affirm," meaning to decline, reject, or say no to something. (इंकार करना)
 
 
• **Example: **She refused to participate in the event despite several requests.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'affirm'** is **'refuse'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Refuse**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Accept **(स्वीकार करना): To agree to receive or take something willingly.

 
 
• **Example: **He accepted the job offer with great enthusiasm.
 
 
 
• **Acknowledge **(स्वीकार करना): To recognize the existence, truth, or importance of something.
 
 
• **Example: **She acknowledged her mistake and apologized sincerely.
 
 
 
• **Support **(समर्थन करना): To back, assist, or provide help to someone or something.
 
 
• **Example: **His family supported him during his challenging times.
